sentences.text: You'd think snails were decorative until a hundred of them mob one sinking algae wafer. A note went home reminding parents that weekend fish-sitting includes the air pump, the dechlorinator drops, and the observation checklist. Water changes go faster now that the python hooks straight to the kitchen faucet. Over the long weekend the filter hummed alone in Room 12, and Principal Vance stopped by twice with the spare key. "Two pinches, not a fistful, Jayden — you'll cloud the whole bowl again." A thermometer suctioned crooked to the glass has read 78 degrees, steady, since Tuesday. "Who fed Nugget twice?" Ms. Okafor asked, holding up the flake canister with its lid already loose. Somebody returned the Thanksgiving sign-up sheet with three names crossed out and a suspicious smear of orange marker. Priya insists her weekend shift ended Sunday at noon, so Monday's cloudy water is officially somebody else's problem. We'll cure the new driftwood in a bucket for a week so the tannins don't turn everything amber. Did you unplug the heater before the water line dropped below its coil? The siphon hose bucked in my hand until gravel dust clouded the bucket like weak tea. Please note that impeller assemblies should be scrubbed with a dedicated toothbrush, never with household detergents. Every Sunday she tops off the aquarium with dechlorinated water warmed to match the glass. During Friday's lesson on habitats, the class measured how quickly Goldie surfaces when the fluorescent lights flick on. Next week the fourth graders will chart Peach's growth in centimeters against the flake rations recorded on the clipboard. Per the laminated rota taped beside the aquarium, Thursday feeding duties belong to Table Four, not to whoever arrives first. Ammonia at zero, nitrite at zero, nitrates creeping toward forty — time for a thirty-percent water change. Feed sparingly on Fridays; whatever the platies miss will rot beneath the sword plants by morning. Somewhere behind the heater cord, the bristlenose pleco rasped at the glass, leaving faint clean trails through the algae film. You haven't lived until twenty second-graders argue about whose turn it is to scrub algae off the glass. What is the meaning of the word tank?
